title: The Battle Belongs to The Lord

bible_verses.english: He said, "Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat: This is what Yahweh says to you: 'Don't be afraid, nor be dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

No weapon that is formed against you will prosper; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh's servants, and their righteousness is of me," says Yahweh.
For Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You that I do not have to carry the weight of life's battles on my own. When challenges surround me, help me to put on Your armor and stand firm in faith. Remind my heart today that no weapon formed against me will stand because You fight for me. I give You all the glory, honor, and strength, trusting that the victory is already Yours. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings struggles that feel overwhelming, but scripture reminds us that we do not fight in our own strength. Clothed in God's heavenly armor, we can step forward with quiet confidence, knowing that Christ has already won the ultimate victory. When fear or opposition arises, our highest calling is not to strive endlessly, but to lift our voices in praise. As we surrender our battles to Him, we discover true peace in His unfailing power.
